newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel weakened against the dollar and the basket of foreign currencies in quiet trading, dealers said.

"After the setting of the representative rate on Tuesday the shekel fell sharply and the dollar opened today at 3.2650 shekels. During the day the shekel rose a little following the dollar's decline against the mark," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.

"Trading was very quiet and activity was low. Most investors are sitting on the fence waiting for the central bank's interest rate announcement on Monday. Until then the market will continue to show nervousness," he said.
The central bank's key lending rate is now at an annual 15.5 percent.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2510 shekels against 3.2460 on Tuesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6394 shekels against 3.6251 on Tuesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8844 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8956 on Tuesday and against the mark at 2.1385 shekels against 2.1171 on Tuesday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2500 shekels.
